tasks.title: Add status and summary to the envelope, derived centrally and reported by each tool's Result
steps: Write TS-05-6..TS-05-12 in internal/toolio/envelope_test.go and confirm they fail

In internal/toolio/envelope.go, add Status and Summary string fields (json:"status" and json:"summary", never omitempty) to Envelope, and reorder every Envelope field in the struct declaration to: Tool, Version, OK, Status, ExitCode, Summary, Error, a placeholder NeedsHuman *NeedsHuman (type stubbed here, fully wired in task 3) with json:"needs_human,omitempty", Warnings, Result, Input, Usage, Model, DurationMS, StartedAt — Go's encoding/json follows struct-field order, so this fixes the wire order in one place

Add a package-level function mapping the five exit codes (ExitOK, ExitFailed, ExitUsage, ExitNeedsHuman, ExitUnverified) to "done", "failed", "usage", "needs_human", "unverified" and call it from Run.Envelope to set Status from the code argument it already receives — never settable by a tool

Define a Summarizer interface { Summary() string } and type-assert the result value passed to Run.Envelope against it, the same way Envelope already special-cases a typed-nil result; when it returns a non-empty string, truncate to 200 characters for env.Summary
When the assertion fails or returns empty: if OK is false, fall back to env.Error.Message; if OK is true, fall back to fmt.Sprintf("%s: done", r.tool)

After the summary is chosen, if OK is true and any recorded warning has severity "high" (Warnings is still []string at this point; treat any entry as candidate until task 6 introduces structured severity — for now, hold this check behind a small severity-aware accessor on Run that task 6 will wire fully), append one fixed, deterministic clause naming the count of high-severity warnings and that the highest severity present is high

Implement Summary() string on codefix.Result (codefix/types.go): mention the commit and branch when Commit/Branch are set, the Verdict, whether it landed, or that it asked a question when Ambiguity is set
Implement Summary() string on codeimpl.Result (codeimpl/types.go): mention TasksDone/TasksTotal, Branch, and the verdict of the task or repair that stopped it when one did
Implement Summary() string on issuetriage.Result (issuetriage/pipeline.go): mention Action, URL/Number, Severity and len(AffectedFiles)
Implement Summary() string on specgen.Result (specgen/pipeline.go): mention the package(s) written, the count of OpenQuestions when non-empty, and for a split, how many of how many scopes
Run gofmt and go vet
